passive.name: Umbra Blades
passive.text: Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself. Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.

spells.name: Duskbringer
spells.text: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

spells.name: Shroud of Darkness
spells.text: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.

spells.name: Unspeakable Horror
spells.text: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.

spells.name: Paranoia
spells.text: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

damage.value: Nocturne deals physical burst damage to eliminate priority targets.

archetype.value: Nocturne is a jungle diver and assassin who uses swift engagements to pick off isolated targets.

axis.value: Nocturne favors decisive all-ins over prolonged fights.

winCondition.value: Nocturne wins by using map pressure to create picks and secure crucial kills.

spikes.at: Nocturne gets stronger when Paranoia is available
spikes.why: Nocturne can join fights across the map and pressure mispositioned targets.

spikes.at: Nocturne gets stronger with Axiom Arc
spikes.why: Nocturne can reduce his ultimate cooldown after a takedown and engage more often.
Nocturne can restrict enemy vision and launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

mistakes.value: Nocturne loses Unspeakable Horror’s fear if its target leaves range before the duration ends.
